WITH e AS (
 SELECT e.*, m.member_id, m.marketing_consent, m.valid_from, m.valid_to, m.join_date
 FROM fact_campaign_exposure e LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
h AS (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19)
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM e) rows_,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT exposure_id) FROM e) dist_exp_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM e WHERE member_id IS NULL) no_member,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM e) members,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM e WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM h)) in_both,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM e WHERE NOT marketing_consent) noconsent_version,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM e WHERE CAST(contact_ts_utc AS DATE) NOT BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-03' AND DATE '2026-05-25') outside_window,
 (SELECT min(contact_ts_utc) FROM e) mn, (SELECT max(contact_ts_utc) FROM e) mx,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM h) holdout_distinct,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h) holdout_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_campaign_contact_load WHERE campaign_id=19) stg_rows

WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
  WHERE e.campaign_id = 19),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, m.member_id, f.net_amount, f.receipt_id,
         (w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_web, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND (s.store_id < 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL))
SELECT count(DISTINCT t.member_id) targeted_members,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' THEN l.member_id END) buyers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' THEN l.net_amount END) spend_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND NOT is_web THEN l.net_amount END) store_spend,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND is_web THEN l.net_amount END) web_spend,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND staff_purchase_flag THEN l.net_amount END) staff_spend
FROM targeted t LEFT JOIN lines l ON l.member_id = t.member_id

WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
  WHERE e.campaign_id = 19),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, m.member_id, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND (s.store_id < 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL))
SELECT 19 AS campaign_id, 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted,
  (SELECT SUM(l.net_amount) FROM lines l JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id = l.member_id
   WHERE l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24') AS net_sales_before_returns_eur
